title: Nazi disc-shaped craft projects (Miethe, Schriever, Lutzow)

tellings.quote: You've got Miethe, Schriever, Lutzow. Um there's like four or five other individuals who all claim to have worked on what appeared to be multiple different attempts to build disc-shaped craft.

plain: In Nazi Germany in the 1940s, several engineers are said to have worked on separate attempts to build disc-shaped flying craft. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source, listing "Miethe, Schriever, Lutzow", meaning Richard Miethe, Rudolf Schriever and a man named Lutzow, and adding that "four or five other individuals" also claimed to have worked on such projects. If true, some flying-saucer sightings could trace back to human wartime engineering.
